summary: Unit suite (1430 tests) and targeted E2E (time-off-calendar.spec.ts + regressions.spec.ts, 19 tests) all pass, including the new TC-01-E2E-10 regression test. The fix raises the organization-country row's marginBottom from --space-6 (16px) to --space-8 (24px), clearing the hinted dropdown Select's 20px out-of-flow message slot plus a 4px gap, resolving the overlap without touching packages/ds.

notes: The fix is a single inline-style token change (marginBottom: var(--space-6) -> var(--space-8)) on the organization-country row in apps/web/app/org/[orgId]/settings/holidays/page.tsx, plus the added TC-01-E2E-10 test in e2e/tests/time-off-calendar.spec.ts.
The known left-edge misalignment (hint vs label inset) is left unresolved as documented in the spec's Known Gaps, and is out of scope for this bug.
